description.text:
Grants Tactical Awoken Mode & +500 ATK to user
Tactical Awoken Mode: Earth/Fire/Lightning Ability Boost, Triplecast Earth/Fire/Lightning, Unlimited Earth/Fire/Lightning Hones, Cap Break Level 1 to Earth/Fire/Lightning Abilities, Earth/Fire/Lightning Ability Damage +30% & ATB Speed x1.1 to Earth/Fire/Lightning Abilities; Ends after using 8 Earth/Fire/Lightning abilities
TP Max: AOE Earth/NE, Fire/NE or Lightning/NE physical attack at True Cap Break Level 1 under En-Earth, En-Fire or En-Lightning
